blocks.title: Helping you reduce risk and improve efficiency.
blocks.intro: Independent assurance of safety, technical and environmental compliance to improve the integrity, reliability and success of your operations.

elements.html:
We understand that a day’s downtime could cost you a six-figure sum, and that marginal gains in efficiency can transform your bottom line. As one of the world’s largest and most respected classification societies, we provide independent, third party assurance of safety, technical and environmental compliance. Our early involvement at every stage of the asset lifecycle can dramatically reduce risks, and improve efficiency, saving you time and money.

But in today’s industry, cost-conscious compliance alone isn’t enough to win, retain
and reassure customers and stakeholders. Through our extensive consultancy services,
supported by excellent project management and working relationships, we address
challenges, achieve milestones, and help you maximise opportunities.

elements.html: With an international network, we have an unrivalled view of the developments shaping the shipping industry.

We apply our expert solutions and independence to assure the integrity, reliability and success of every aspect of your operation. Helping maximise productivity and recovery, reduce operating costs, mitigate risk and demonstrate compliance with government regulations, industry codes and standards, many of which we have helped to develop.
